questions.explanation: Match a short lamp. One distractor is the same object with the opposite dimension, one is the other object with the requested dimension, and one differs in both. All drawings use the same visible frame.
questions.hint: Use the complete material and the question together.
questions.difficultyReason: New provisional original for this level; no independent learner calibration claimed.

entries.reviewNotes: Thirty-two new owned length/height-plus-object picture examples in eight complete four-picture practices. All vector geometry is newly authored; identity, bounds, contrast and no answer-text leakage reviewed on a contact sheet. Counts describe picture-word scoring items, not new independent stories. Vocabulary provisional, no independent calibration claimed. 每道题保存了正确键和所有干扰项的具体辨析。
